nodes.name: cve-checker.js
nodes.summary: Queries the OSV vulnerability database to check npm/PyPI packages for known CVEs and computes a numeric threat score from severity counts.

nodes.name: CVEChecker
nodes.summary: Queries the OSV API for package vulnerabilities, parses CVSS severity scores, and computes a numeric threat score from the resulting vulnerability set.

nodes.name: decision-tree.js
nodes.summary: Evaluates all security scan results through a weighted decision tree to produce a final risk score (SILENT/WHINE/BARK) and human-readable reasons.

nodes.name: DecisionTree
nodes.summary: Aggregates VirusTotal, reputation, CVE, and pattern scan results through configurable weighted scoring rules to produce a final threat decision with formatted reasons.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Main entry point and orchestrator for guard-dog: instantiates all checkers, runs the full scan pipeline (reputation, VirusTotal, CVE, patterns, decision), and dispatches CLI subcommands.

nodes.name: GuardDog
nodes.summary: Core orchestrator class that instantiates and coordinates all security checkers, executes the full analysis pipeline for a package, and persists scan history to disk.

nodes.name: pattern-analyzer.js
nodes.summary: Scans package source code against a library of suspicious regex patterns (obfuscation, exfiltration, process spawning) to detect malicious code behaviour.

nodes.name: PatternAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Applies a ruleset of regex patterns across package source files to detect suspicious code constructs and assigns a suspicion score based on match counts and pattern severities.

nodes.name: reputation-checker.js
nodes.summary: Fetches package metadata from npm, PyPI, and RubyGems registries plus GitHub to produce reputation signals such as download count, age, maintainer count, and repository health.

nodes.name: ReputationChecker
nodes.summary: Fetches and analyses package metadata across npm, PyPI, RubyGems, and GitHub to generate reputation signals indicating package trustworthiness.

nodes.name: telegram-alert.js
nodes.summary: Sends Telegram notifications when a package scan reaches BARK-level danger, formatting the decision tree output into a structured alert message.

nodes.name: TelegramAlert
nodes.summary: Wraps the Telegram Bot API to send formatted danger alerts and test bot connectivity when a high-risk package is detected.

nodes.name: virustotal-scanner.js
nodes.summary: Submits package URLs or file hashes to the VirusTotal API and parses antivirus detection results into a structured scan report.

nodes.name: VirusTotalScanner
nodes.summary: Interfaces with the VirusTotal v3 API to scan URLs and retrieve file hash reports, parsing detection statistics into a structured result object.

nodes.name: test.js
nodes.summary: Unit and integration test suite for guard-dog covering CVE checking, reputation signals, pattern detection, decision tree evaluation, Telegram formatting, and scan history persistence.

nodes.name: TestRunner
nodes.summary: Minimal synchronous test harness that runs named test cases, records pass/fail results with assertion messages, and prints a summary report.
